code='''def transform(grid):
    # The lower pattern is retained; the rightmost upper pattern is placed
    # directly above it, aligned to its bounding box.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid[6:15]]
    lower = [(r, c) for r in range(6, 15) for c in range(15) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)]
    upper_right = [(r, c) for r in range(1, 4) for c in range(10, 13) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in lower), max(r for r, c in lower)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in lower), max(c for r, c in lower)
    ur0, ur1 = min(r for r, c in upper_right), max(r for r, c in upper_right)
    uc0, uc1 = min(c for r, c in upper_right), max(c for r, c in upper_right)
    for r, c in upper_right:
        rr = (r - ur0) + (r0 - 6) - (ur1 - ur0 + 1)
        cc = (c - uc0) + c0
        out[rr][cc] = grid[r][c]
    return out
'''
